title: 2.9 Count and Describe
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with un/una and el/la, count them, and say their color and size with the right ending.
goal: Count colored things: dos carros azules, tres plumas amarillas; the color comes after the noun and matches it.

cards.pedagogy_note: plural /s/ target but A1 scoring remains forgiving
